name: awesome-claude-plugins
desc: A curated list of Plugins that let you extend Claude Code with custom commands, agents, hooks, and MCP servers through the plugin system.

resources.name: kaggle-skill
resources.desc: Complete Kaggle integration — account setup, competition reports, dataset/model downloads, notebook execution, submissions, and badge collection.

resources.name: AgentLint
resources.desc: Lint your repo for AI agent compatibility. 33 evidence-backed checks across 5 dimensions. Claude Code plugin.

resources.name: maestro-orchestrate
resources.desc: Multi-agent development orchestration coordinating 22 specialized subagents through 4-phase workflows with native parallel execution, persistent sessions, and standalone commands for code review, debugging, security audit, and more.

resources.name: MyVibe
resources.desc: Instant deployment to live URLs with /myvibe:publish.

resources.name: aws-cost-saver
resources.desc: Automated AWS cost optimization with 173 checks across EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, and more. ML-powered recommendations and real pricing from AWS API.

resources.name: Manifest
resources.desc: Real-time cost observability for OpenClaw agents — track tokens, costs, messages, and model usage. Includes Claude Code skill for guided setup. Self-hosted, OTLP ingestion, 28+ LLM models. (Website)

resources.name: security-sweep
resources.desc: Comprehensive security scanner covering OWASP Top 10 (2025), Mobile Top 10 (2024), and LLM Top 10 (2025). Scans for hardcoded secrets, injection flaws, auth issues, misconfigurations, and AI-specific vulnerabilities.

resources.name: asqav-claude-code
resources.desc: Signs a tamper-evident Asqav receipt at the end of each Claude Code session: files edited (content hashes before/after), commands run (hashed), and git context. Verifiable by anyone at asqav.com/verify.

resources.name: CCHub
resources.desc: Desktop app for managing the Claude Code ecosystem — MCP marketplace, config profiles, skills & plugins browser, workflow templates, security audit. Built with Tauri v2 + React + Rust.

resources.name: context-mode
resources.desc: Process large outputs in sandboxed subprocesses, keeping only summaries in the context window. 98% context savings across 21 benchmarked scenarios.

resources.name: codebase-graph
resources.desc: Code intelligence MCP server that builds knowledge graphs from source code with 42-language tree-sitter AST parsing and FalkorDB.

resources.name: agntk
resources.desc: Zero-config AI agent CLI with persistent named agents, 20+ built-in tools, and hardware-aware local model selection.

resources.name: backlog
resources.desc: Persistent, cross-session task management. 24 MCP tools for tasks, projects, tags, dependencies, and docs. 7 skills for planning, standups, and handoffs. Event-sourced storage, agent coordination, pure TypeScript. (Website)

resources.name: claude-familiar
resources.desc: Enhance Claude Code's /buddy companion with personality, mood, lore, and interactive commands (fortune, roast, haiku, focus timer). Mood shifts automatically on tool success/failure. Extensible — other plugins can layer traits and lore via "x-familiarExtensions" in their plugin.json.

resources.name: nano-banana
resources.desc: Google Gemini image generation plugin. Text-to-image, text-guided image editing, style transfer, 4K output, search grounding, and multi-reference composition — all from a single /genimage command. Powered by gemini-2.5-flash-image and gemini-3-pro-image-preview.

resources.name: taisly-agent-kit
resources.desc: Claude Code plugin, skill, SDK, CLI, and MCP server for publishing short-form videos to TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and Facebook through Taisly.
